source.title: OASIS-E2 All Items
source.note: Verbatim text for a 24-field slice of CMS-authored items. Excluded for licensing: A1255 (NACHC PRAPARE, no redistribution), B1300 (CC BY-NC 4.0), D0150 (PHQ, Pfizer copyright). N0415 uses column 1 (Is taking) only. M1100 grid labels are joined as 'row | column'.

fields.title: Birth Date
fields.question: Birth Date

fields.title: Ethnicity
fields.question: Are you of Hispanic, Latino/a, or Spanish origin?
options: No, not of Hispanic, Latino/a, or Spanish origin
Yes, another Hispanic, Latino, or Spanish origin

fields.title: Race
fields.question: What is your race?

fields.title: Current Payment Sources for Home Care
fields.question: Current Payment Sources for Home Care
options: None; no charge for current services
Title programs (for example, Title III, V, or XX)

fields.title: Language
fields.question: A. What is your preferred language?

fields.title: Language
fields.question: B. Do you need or want an interpreter to communicate with a doctor or health care staff?

fields.title: Repetition of Three Words
fields.ask: I am going to say three words for you to remember. Please repeat the words after I have said all three. The words are: sock, blue, and bed. Now tell me the three words.
fields.question: Number of words repeated after first attempt:

fields.title: Temporal Orientation (Orientation to year, month, and day)
fields.ask: Please tell me what year it is right now.
fields.question: A. Able to report correct year
options: Missed by > 5 years or no answer

fields.title: Temporal Orientation (Orientation to year, month, and day)
fields.ask: What month are we in right now?
fields.question: B. Able to report correct month
options: Missed by > 1 month or no answer

fields.title: Temporal Orientation (Orientation to year, month, and day)
fields.ask: What day of the week is today?
fields.question: C. Able to report correct day of the week

fields.title: Social Isolation
fields.question: How often do you feel lonely or isolated from those around you?

fields.title: Patient Living Situation
fields.question: Which of the following best describes the patient’s residential circumstance and availability of assistance?

rows: Patient lives with other person(s) in the home
Patient lives in congregate situation (for example, assisted living, residential care home)

fields.title: Prior Functioning: Everyday Activities
fields.question: A. Self Care: Code the patient’s need for assistance with bathing, dressing, using the toilet, and eating prior to the current illness, exacerbation, or injury.

fields.title: Prior Functioning: Everyday Activities
fields.question: B. Indoor Mobility (Ambulation): Code the patient’s need for assistance with walking from room to room (with or without a device such as cane, crutch or walker) prior to the current illness, exacerbation, or injury.

fields.title: Prior Functioning: Everyday Activities
fields.question: C. Stairs: Code the patient’s need for assistance with internal or external stairs (with or without a device such as cane, crutch, or walker) prior to the current illness, exacerbation, or injury.

fields.title: Prior Functioning: Everyday Activities
fields.question: D. Functional Cognition: Code the patient’s need for assistance with planning regular tasks, such as shopping or remembering to take medication prior to the current illness, exacerbation, or injury.

fields.title: Prior Device Use
fields.question: Indicate devices and aids used by the patient prior to the current illness, exacerbation, or injury.

fields.title: Risk for Hospitalization
fields.question: Which of the following signs or symptoms characterize this patient as at risk for hospitalization?
options: History of falls (2 or more falls — or any fall with an injury — in the past 12 months)
Unintentional weight loss of a total of 10 pounds or more in the last 12 months
Multiple hospitalizations (2 or more) in the past 6 months
Multiple emergency department visits (2 or more) in the past 6 months
Decline in mental, emotional, or behavioral status in the past 3 months
Reported or observed history of difficulty complying with any medical instructions (for example, medications, diet, exercise) in the past 3 months

fields.title: Pain Effect on Sleep
fields.ask: Over the past 5 days, how much of the time has pain made it hard for you to sleep at night?
fields.question: Pain Effect on Sleep
options: Does not apply — I have not had any pain or hurting in the past 5 days

fields.title: Pain Interference with Day-to-Day Activities
fields.ask: Over the past 5 days, how often you have limited your day-to-day activities (excluding rehabilitation therapy sessions) because of pain?
fields.question: Pain Interference with Day-to-Day Activities

fields.title: When is the patient dyspneic or noticeably Short of Breath?
fields.question: When is the patient dyspneic or noticeably Short of Breath?
options: Patient is not short of breath
When walking more than 20 feet, climbing stairs
With moderate exertion (for example, while dressing, using commode or bedpan, walking distances less than 20 feet)
With minimal exertion (for example, while eating, talking, or performing other ADLs) or with agitation

fields.title: Height and Weight
fields.instruction: While measuring, if the number is X.1-X.4 round down; X.5 or greater round up.
fields.question: A. Height (in inches). Record most recent height measure since the most recent SOC/ROC

fields.title: Height and Weight
fields.instruction: While measuring, if the number is X.1-X.4 round down; X.5 or greater round up.
fields.question: B. Weight (in pounds). Base weight on most recent measure in last 30 days; measure weight consistently, according to standard agency practice (for example, in a.m. after voiding, before meal, with shoes off, etc.)

fields.title: High-Risk Drug Classes: Use and Indication
fields.question: 1. Is taking: Check if the patient is taking any medications by pharmacological classification, not how it is used, in the following classes

GG0100: Independent – Patient completed all the activities by themself, with or without an assistive device, with no assistance from a helper.
Needed Some Help – Patient needed partial assistance from another person to complete any activities.
Dependent – A helper completed all the activities for the patient.

skip_rules.note: J0510 is 0, no pain in the past 5 days
